# Windows (x86_64) qwen venv -- the mirror of requirements_qwen_mac.txt for the
# Windows kit. Verified installing + generating on Windows 11 + RTX 3080
# (torch 2.8.0+cu128, Python 3.11) on 2026-08-12.
#
# torch/torchaudio are NOT listed here: the CUDA build is installed separately
# from the pytorch.org cu128 index by installSpec.js (buildSteps: torchCuda)
# BEFORE this file, because plain PyPI torch on Windows is CPU-only.

# The sidecar itself (sidecar/server.py) is a small FastAPI app.
fastapi
uvicorn[standard]
python-multipart

# The qwen-tts package itself (from PyPI, verified: qwen-tts==0.1.1)
qwen-tts==0.1.1

# qwen-tts's own dependencies, pinned to the server's working versions.
accelerate==1.12.0
einops==0.8.2
gradio==6.17.3
librosa==0.11.0
onnxruntime==1.27.0
soundfile==0.14.0
transformers==4.57.3
# pysox wrapper. On Windows it warns "SoX not found" at import when no sox.exe
# is on PATH, but the timbre-clone path used by the app does not call it, so
# generation still succeeds (verified 2026-08-12).
sox==1.5.0
numpy==2.4.6
